name: Teamworks Summer Camp (Somerset)
description_short: A weekly day camp for ages 4–14 at the Teamworks indoor sports center in Somerset, MA. Options include a general sports and games camp (Cubs for ages 4–6, TW Camp for ages 7–14), TW Friends (dance, fashion, arts and crafts, jewelry) and sport-specialty camps for beginner and intermediate players.
